transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my eating has gotten completely off track. I stopped caring about tracking my food, skipped actual meals for days, and mostly lived on coffee and protein bars. Then I noticed my clothes were hanging loose—I guess I’d lost weight without really paying attention.
During this time when your eating changed, how has your overall mood been?

My mood was really up for days. I felt unstoppable, like I had all these brilliant ideas and nobody could keep up. But if someone asked me a simple question or tried to slow me down, I’d snap at them—like they were sabotaging the whole company.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt deeply depressed or down for weeks at a time?
Yeah. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, it felt like the bottom dropped out. I just sat in my apartment feeling hollow and ashamed, crying over emails I normally would’ve handled.
